name: Intercom
description: Intercom support channel plugin (polling + webhook inbound, auto-reply)

adminId.description: Bot admin id; auto-resolved via GET /me when omitted

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Poll interval for assigned open conversations

webhookSecret.description: Intercom app client secret used to verify X-Hub-Signature

allowFrom.description: Optional allowlist of Intercom contact ids

pickupUnassigned.description: Also answer open conversations that are unassigned (Messenger/widget visitors land unassigned) and claim them for the bot admin

autoClose.description: Close a conversation after replying when the agent emits a [[close]] directive or the customer's message reads as resolved (thanks, that's all)

escalationAssigneeId.description: Teammate (admin) or team id the bot hands off to when the agent emits [[escalate]]

escalationAssigneeType.description: Whether escalationAssigneeId refers to a teammate (admin) or a team

createMissingTags.description: Create tags that don't exist yet when the agent emits [[tag: ...]]

contactContext.description: Fetch the customer's Intercom contact profile and give it to the agent as reply context

persona.description: Voice/identity the agent adopts when replying to customers (e.g. 'You are Ocean from Cowrywise Support — warm, direct, professional.'). Defaults to a neutral, professional support persona when unset.

maxConcurrentConversations.description: How many conversations the agent works on at once. Each conversation is finished (reply, notes, tags, then close or escalate) before that worker starts another.

rateLimitPerMinute.description: Ceiling on outbound Intercom API requests per minute, retries included. Set below your workspace plan's limit.
